sections.title: Upper and lower Abba and Ima: Yisroel Saba and Tevuna, and the mazalos that give souls
sections.summary: The union of the upper *Abba* and *Ima* is the couple as husband and wife; the lower, *Yisroel Saba* and *Tevuna*, is them as father and mother, the intellect as it is revealed outward, felt in *Yisroel Saba* and explained in *Tevuna*. To give *mochin* to *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva* for the birth of souls, the union must reach up to the two *mazalos* of *Arich*: a soul needs the essence of the intellect, not yet set in a form.

phrases.he: (וזהו ענין יחוד אבא ואמא עילאין ויחוד אבא ואמא תתאין,
phrases.en: and this is the idea of the upper union of *Abba* and *Ima*, and the lower union of *Abba* and *Ima*.

phrases.he: שהוא ישראל סבא ותבונה, כמו שכתוב למעלה בענין בינה ותבונה באריכות
ובחינת ישראל סבא הוא ו׳ קצוות דאבא ותבונה ו׳ קצוות דאימא

blocks.text: **This is the idea of the upper union of Abba and Ima, and the lower union of Abba and Ima.** The upper one is *Abba* and *Ima*; the lower one is *Yisroel Saba* and *Tevuna*, as was explained above at length about *bina* and *tevuna*; and *Yisroel Saba* is the six directions of *Abba*, and *Tevuna* the six directions of *Ima*: the intellect of the lower union. So there is an upper and a lower union. "So the upper is the, wait, what is he going to say?"

phrases.he: ויש עוד ישראל סבא למעלה גם מאבא ואמא עילאין
שהוא ו׳ קצוות דחכמה סתימאה דאריך אנפין
ותבונה ו׳ קצוות דבינה דאריך אנפין
שמשם נמשך שורש יחוד אבא ואמא עלאין בבחינת ג׳ ראשין שבהן כו')

blocks.text: There is also a *Yisroel Saba* above, higher even than the upper *Abba* and *Ima*: the six directions of the hidden *chachma* of *Arich Anpin*, and a *Tevuna*, the six directions of the *bina* of *Arich Anpin*; from there comes the root of the union of the upper *Abba* and *Ima* in their *gimmel reishin* (three heads). So in the union of *Abba* and *Ima* you can have the union of *chachma* and *bina* in their pure state, a union for their own revelation, not for the children. There is the father and mother the way they are husband and wife, and the way they are father and mother. The way they are husband and wife is the upper union; the way they are father and mother is the lower, *Yisroel Saba* and *Tevuna*. In the *mashal*, *Abba* and *Ima* are like the personality of the father and mother, their spiritual self, their *mochin* and *middos*; and *Yisroel Saba* and *Tevuna* are like the reproductive organs, the physical father-and-mother part of them: the *middos* of the *chachma* as they are revealed outward.

But really there is a *Yisroel Saba* and *Tevuna* higher than that, in *Arich*, higher than the upper *Abba* and *Ima*, and the root of their union comes from there. It says that a really smart person, who really has the essence of the intellect, is able to explain it to a little kid; that is what is coming soon. In chapter two he explained *bina* and *tevuna*.

The difference between *Yisroel Saba* and *chachma* is the same thing: one is pure intellect and one is applied intellect. It was explained there that *tevuna* is the *middos* of *bina*, the way they are revealed outward: the *middos* of the intellect, what the intellect dictates about whether a thing is good or bad and how it should be done. *Tevuna* would be like learning *Shulchan Aruch*, as opposed to learning *Gemara*, because in the *Gemara* even the *halacha* is hidden in the pure abstract thing, not just the deed; "the way that we learn *Gemara*, at least." And the same with *chachma*: the difference between the *middos* of *chachma* and the *middos* of *bina*, between *Yisroel Saba* and *Tevuna*, is just whether you can explain it or not. Like when Rav knew the *halacha* was a certain way but could not explain why, he just felt it: that is like *Yisroel Saba*, when you just feel that you should not do it that way, but you do not know why.

Normally the pure intellect is higher than the application. But there is a higher will, a higher level of the application, that is in a way higher than the pure intellect. That is the idea that the real thing of the Torah is doing the *mitzvos*, and in a way the real essence of it comes out when you are able to apply it: when you actually do the Torah and *mitzvos* and experience it, that is really what the Torah is. That is really what made you want to understand even the pure thing of it: first of all, that itself is a *mitzva*, and also, even the highest things should be able to come out in some way as an applied thing.

blocks.title: Parents and the will for children
blocks.text: Even if not in a particular way, just that your attitude is that you want to be connected to G-d, *lishma*: that is the spirit of the law, which lets you get the letter of the law right. Or take the *mashal* of parents. Even though they have an essential relationship which precedes, and is in a way higher than, having kids, the whole idea of coming together and getting married is mainly to make a family. That will is really what brought them together in the first place. So in a way their whole relationship is based on the idea of having kids; they are not just friends. What gives them that deep relationship is the inner will to bring it out in deed. Because there is such an essential, strong will for children and a family, that is what makes the love between a husband and wife so strong, for it is not an essential thing in itself. It is not like a father and a son, where it is essential. The love between a husband and wife starts off *talui b'davar* (dependent on a thing), and then it is revealed to be an essential thing. But it starts off dependent on a thing.
So the six directions of *Abba* are the intuitive halachic thing, when you cannot explain it but you have a *daas Torah* (a Torah sense): a *chush*, a feeling.

phrases.he: והנה כאשר נמשך מאבא ואמא מוחין לזעיר אנפין ונוקבה בשביל תולדות הנשמות,
phrases.en: when *Abba* is giving brains to *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva* in order to give birth to souls,

phrases.he: צריך להיות היחוד באבא ואמא בפנימית המוחין, בשרשם בב' מזלות דאריך אנפין
phrases.en: then there has to go to the *pnimiyus* of *Abba*, all the way up to the two *mazalos*.

phrases.he: (והיינו בני כו' במזלא תליה כו')
phrases.en: To have children and also *chayei u'mezonei* depends on the *mazal*.

blocks.text: **When Abba is giving brains to Zeir Anpin and Nukva in order to give birth to souls**, the union has to be in the inner *mochin*, at their root in the two *mazalos* of *Arich Anpin*. When you want to have kids, when there are to be souls, **then there has to go to the pnimiyus of Abba, all the way up to the two mazalos**. Why? As explained elsewhere: this is what it says, *banei, chayei u'mezonei b'mazla talya*: **to have children and also chayei u'mezonei** (life and sustenance) **depends on the mazal**. You have to connect to the *mazal*.

The idea is that if you want it to be a soul, a living thing that can change, you have to get the essence of the intellect. For example, if you want to be able to *paskenen* (rule on) *halacha*, it is not good enough to learn *halacha*; "and the Gra says this": you have to know *pnimiyus haTorah* (the inner Torah), which is like *Abba* in its essence. Why? Because you have to know the real goal, you have to know G-d and what He likes, the real spirit of the law. You cannot just say, "Just tell me what to do and I'll do it." That is not going to be good enough, because there are always going to be gray areas, unless you appreciate the thing itself, what you are trying to accomplish and what the Torah is, on a deeper level that is not directly connected to deed. You still have to have that.

Otherwise it will not be a soul. It will be like an angel, which can just do what it is told, like a machine, but it will not be able to make a choice. So to give birth to souls, which have free choice and are able to do things creatively, there has to be a revelation of the inner *mochin*: G-d has to put a *chelek* (portion) of His essence into it. A *neshama* (soul) has to come from the inner side of *Abba*, at the level of the *mazal*, which is not yet limited in a form. If it were limited in a form, it would just be set in one way. But this way, souls have a revelation of the way G-d transcends every limitation, and therefore they are able to have free choice. They are at the level of the essence.

blocks.title: The liquid over the brain, and stem cells
blocks.text: The same with the physical making of a baby: you have to bring down some of the liquid over the brain, which is like the hidden *mochin*, the essence of the life before it is connected to a particular form. It is kind of like stem cells and those kinds of things: they are not defined, so they can turn into anything. In order to have a child, you have to bring out the parts of you that are just the essence of life, not defined yet, which could be made into anything, so that it can be made into something new.

sections.title: Kel Elyon and the great sage who can teach a child: why souls are born from above the intellect
sections.summary: *Kel Elyon* is the inner light of *Abba* going up to the *mazal*; from there *yesod* gives good kindnesses and "acquires everything". The *mashal*: only a *chacham muflag* who knows an idea at its source can explain it to a little child or bring out a new idea from it. So too souls are born only from a union of *Abba* and *Ima* that reaches above the source of their intellect, to the *mazalos*; and that is why it is on the night of *Shabbos*.

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב במקום אחר
שזהו ענין אל עליון,
phrases.en: this idea of *Kel Elyon*, the upper force, the upper power.

phrases.he: עליית אור פנימית אבא כשמקבל ממזל ונוצר כו'
phrases.en: That is when the light of *Abba*, the *pnimiyus* light of *Abba*, receives from the *mazal v'notzer*.

blocks.text: This is the idea of *Kel Elyon*: **the upper force, the upper power**. *Kel* is a name of G-d, but *Kel* means power; and *Kel Elyon* is the rising of the inner light of *Abba* when it receives from the *mazal v'notzer*. *Kel* is the light of *chachma*, and *Kel Elyon* means when the light of *chachma* goes up to its source, in the *mazal v'notzer*, from the *mocha stima'a*.

phrases.he: אז גומל חסדים טובים,
phrases.en: then it's able to give over good kindnesses,

phrases.he: בבחינת יסוד
phrases.en: in a way of *yesod*,

phrases.he: שנקרא קונה הכל,
phrases.en: which is called, acquires everything,

phrases.he: להוליד תולדות בזעיר אנפין ונוקבה
phrases.en: to give birth in *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva*.

blocks.text: **Then it's able to give over good kindnesses, in a way of yesod** (the attribute of relationship), **which is called, acquires everything**, *koneh hakol*, **to give birth in Zeir Anpin and Nukva**. What does that mean? When you feel the real essence, higher than the intellect, the real essence of the intellect, you are able to aim at the truth. So when you do things, you are able to do them in a way that is really *tovim*, really helpful. *Tov* means that it is actually helpful; *chesed* just means that you are being nice, and you can mean well and not really be helpful. When you appreciate the real essence, you are able to do it properly: that is *yesod*, that is *tov*.

And if it is *koneh hakol*, you are able to acquire things: to have something separate be connected to you and reveal you. Here that is having children: your essence comes across into something separate. To be able to have a child, you have to reach a level higher than the way you are revealed consciously in your body, where that same essence could be revealed in somebody else. Because there is really a level of your soul that could have gone into a different body and been born to different parents, in a different situation, and made different choices in life, and it would have been you too. At that level anything can be connected to it: "it's all yours." Even something totally separate, at that level your soul can connect to it, and that is what acquiring it means. So a child, who is really a separate person from you, at that level can be called yours, because there your essence *mamash* went into it; it is really you.

phrases.he: וזהו וזוכר חסדי אבות ומביא גואל לבני בניהם כו'
phrases.en: And this is what it means that He remembers the kindness of the fathers and brings redemption to the children's children.

blocks.text: **And this is what it means that He remembers the kindness of the fathers and brings redemption to the children's children.** By going up to the source of the intellect, the source of the *avos* (fathers), He is able to bring *geula* (redemption): the inner soul, that they should be a soul to the children and the children's children. Because this is the intellect connected to its source without limitations, in a way of spreading forth, not limited. *Gevura* is the way it comes out in the vessel, in the *mochin*, in a limited, set way; and the *chasdei avos* (kindness of the fathers) is the way it is connected to the source, where it is unlimited and can come out in any way. At that level it can bring *geula* to the *b'nei b'neihem*: *b'neihem*, their children, are the *middos*, and *b'nei b'neihem*, their children's children, are the deed.

phrases.he: והמשל בזה ידוע,
phrases.en: the *mashal* of this is known,

He can make new combinations, explaining it not as it is: **then he's able to explain it in a way that's totally different than the normal natural way that it's explained, which is very abstract and difficult, and he can explain it in a new way that the kid can understand.** **He can also come up with new sechel from it**, giving birth to new ideas, because he has the essence, so it is not limited to its form. He can bring it into any form.

phrases.en: He only understands it as it is, what was explained to him.

phrases.en: So, for him, it's enough that he's able to understand it for himself,

phrases.en: so it comes out the *Nehi* of the *chachma*, which is the *yesod*, the power of being *mashpia*, of teacher, the ability to be a teacher to a student,

phrases.he: מאין ליש דוקא כו'
phrases.en: which brings it from its abstract essence to like a tangible form,

blocks.text: Whereas **somebody that is not a wondrous chacham, he doesn't get the etzem** (essence) **of it that's higher than it**. **He only understands it as it is, what was explained to him**; he does not get the essence that is higher than the way it was explained to him. **So, for him, it's enough that he's able to understand it for himself**, but **he's not able to get anything new from it**, because he can only see it the way it is, in its current form. He cannot find the essence and apply it to other forms. **For sure he can't explain to a child**: he cannot even come up with a *chiddush* within the abstract, intellectual realm, and all the more he cannot see how to apply it to a little child. That is totally irrelevant to him, so low; he sees it as essentially abstract and academic.

**So it comes out the Nehi of the chachma, which is the yesod, the power of being mashpia** (the giver), **of teacher, the ability to be a teacher to a student, depends on the koach hamaskil** (the power of insight), **which is the source of the intellect**, which brings it from nothing to something, **from its abstract essence to like a tangible form**. At that level it is abstract and able to come into any form, so when a person taps into it, he can explain it even in terms of a little kid.

That is why the best thing, if you want to understand *Chassidus* well, is to try to teach it. "It's very important." Just learning it, you are never going to understand it well; you have to teach it.

phrases.he: וכך הוא בענין תולדות הנשמות
phrases.en: same thing with this birth of souls,

phrases.he: מבחינת נה''י
שאינו מוליד כי אם בתוספת כח במקור המוחין שלו מלמעלה מעלה מן השכל כו'
phrases.en: In order for the souls to come out from the *mochin*, spiritually, it has to reveal the *etzem* that's higher than the *sechel*.

phrases.he: והוא הטעם שבשביל תולדות נשמות על ידי יחוד אבא ואמא,
צריך להיות מלמעלה ממקור המוחין דאבא ואמא
phrases.en: That's why it has to go higher than the source of the *mochin* of *Abba*,

phrases.he: שזהו מבחינת מזלות דחכמה סתימאה שהוא למעלה גם מחכמה ובינה דאריך אנפין עצמו כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: the *mazalos* are higher even than the *chachma* and *bina* of *Arich Anpin*, because the *mazalos* go all the way up to the *Keser*, all the way to the *etzem*.

blocks.text: **Same thing with this birth of souls** from *Nehi*: it does not give birth except with an added power in the source of its *mochin*, from far above the intellect. **In order for the souls to come out from the mochin, spiritually, it has to reveal the etzem that's higher than the sechel.** That is the reason that for the birth of souls through the union of *Abba* and *Ima* it has to be from above the source of the *mochin*: **that's why it has to go higher than the source of the mochin of Abba**. And also the other way around: we have to have *mesirus nefesh* for G-d to do miracles and the like, which is also the idea of changing things. That is from the *mazalos*, and **the mazalos are higher even than the chachma and bina of Arich Anpin, because the mazalos go all the way up to the Keser, all the way to the etzem**, as mentioned above.

phrases.he: והיינו טעם ליחוד פנימית דאבא ואמא בליל שבת קודש
phrases.en: this is why the *pnimiyus yichud* of *Abba* is the night of *Shabbos Kodesh*,

phrases.he: מפני שהוא בשביל להוליד נשמות
phrases.en: because it's in order to bring down souls,

phrases.he: שלכך אז דוקא זמן זיווגא דחכימין
phrases.en: and that's why *talmidei chachamim*, their time when they have relations is *davka* on *Shabbos*,

phrases.he: שהן תלמידי חכמים שנקרא קודש,
phrases.en: because *talmidei chachamim* are called *kodesh*,

phrases.he: ושבת שרשו בקודש העליון,
phrases.en: and *Shabbos*, its source is in the *kodesh elyon*,

phrases.he: בחינת פנימית אור אבא כנזכר לעיל ודי למבין:
phrases.en: which is the *pnimiyus* of *Abba*, which receives from the *Keser*.

blocks.text: **This is why the pnimiyus yichud of Abba is the night of Shabbos Kodesh, because it's in order to bring down souls.** **And that's why talmidei chachamim** (Torah scholars), **their time when they have relations is davka on Shabbos**, *zivuga d'chakimin*: **because talmidei chachamim are called kodesh, and Shabbos, its source is in the kodesh elyon** (the higher holiness), **which is the pnimiyus of Abba, which receives from the Keser**. In other words, since *talmidei chachamim* focus on the thing of the inner side of *Abba*, learning Torah *lishma* and appreciating the essential connection to G-d, they *davka* do it on *Shabbos*, which is the time of that thing.

reviewQuestions.question: Why does a person whose intellect receives from the *mazalos* become good at a thing, and what do the hockey cards show?
Why is *Shabbos* called *kodesh* and *oneg*, but *Yom Tov* only *mikra kodesh* and *simcha*?
What does *Drawing on the Right Side of the Brain* teach about the *koach MaH* of *chachma*, and how does naming reveal *Atik* in *bina*?
In what two ways is silence a fence for wisdom, and why does being quiet "get you double"?
How do *netzach* and *hod* of *Abba* hold up the intellect, and what do the lashes and the first offender show?
Why can only a *chacham muflag* explain an idea to a little child, and what does that show about the birth of souls?

Line 36 ("shenikra Abba v'Ima tata'in") is not read in any class: in tape 37 he reads lines 34-35 and goes straight to line 37 (37 w46-103). It is a no-recording passage of its own.

In tape 37 (w0-127) the machine hears "yichud ahava ila'a / tata'a" where the text has "yichud Abba v'Ima ila'in / tata'in"; he probably said "AvA". Kiddush (32 w1279-1322): he says the mitzva d'oraisa is to enjoy, with wine, "I don't think that the mitzva though is to say the kiddush", then that one says it verbally to be mekadesh the day. Kept as he said it in text, and flagged (other) for the public edition, whose publishable text drops the claim. The usual ruling (Rambam, Shabbos 29:1) is that the Torah commandment of kiddush is verbal. Also kept as said: "on Shabbos, if you don't enjoy wine, you're not supposed to have wine" (32 w1461-1478); also flagged, the publishable text drops that sentence.

The TV debate story (34 w552-807): he names "Rabbi Hollander, I think"; the identity is his recollection and is not checked. The publishable text drops the name and the remarks about the Reform rabbi and Reform Judaism.
